mapper.sql: d.id, d.category_id, c.name as category_name, d.title, d.summary, d.cover_url, d.uploader_name, d.view_count, d.file_format, d.page_count, d.point_price, d.access_type, case when d.access_type = 'VIP_FREE' then '会员免费' else '积分兑换' end as access_label
d.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and d.conversion_status = 'SUCCESS' and d.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and c.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select id, user_id, document_id, spent_points, point_record_id, unlock_time, create_time from wl_document_unlock where user_id = #{userId} and document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wl_document_unlock(user_id, document_id, spent_points, point_record_id, unlock_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{documentId}, #{spentPoints}, #{pointRecordId}, #{unlockTime}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0')

insert into wl_favorite(user_id, document_id, favorite_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{documentId}, now(), concat('wx:', #{userId}), now(), '', now(), '0') on duplicate key update favorite_time = now(), update_time = now(), del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update wl_favorite set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from wl_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'

select from wl_document_unlock u inner join wl_document d on d.id = u.document_id inner join wl_category c on c.id = d.category_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and order by u.unlock_time desc, u.id desc

select from wl_favorite f inner join wl_document d on d.id = f.document_id inner join wl_category c on c.id = d.category_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.del_flag = '0' and order by f.favorite_time desc, f.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into wl_document_view(user_id, document_id, view_type, view_time, client_ip, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{documentId}, #{viewType}, now(), #{clientIp}, concat('wx:', #{userId}), now(), '', now(), '0')
mapper.update: update wl_document set view_count = view_count + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{documentId} and publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and del_flag = '0'
